subject: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: AtlasPay Ops <ops@atlaspay.com>; Jay Campbell <jay.campbell@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet

Hi Jay / AtlasPay team,

Attached is our draft postmortem for the May 10 incident that impacted your transaction routing (AP region-us-1). Summary bullets below and a short set of asks so we can close the loop ahead of next week’s QBR: 

- Incident summary: A load-balancer config rollback triggered degraded KV-cache hits for the routing table; requests queued on a subset of hosts for ~27 minutes (peak error rate 4.8%).
- Customer impact window: 2028-05-10 13:14:00 — 2028-05-10 13:41:00 UTC (27 minutes).
- Immediate mitigation: automated rollback + cache rewarming; traffic normalized by 13:42 UTC.

Attachments: AP-postmortem-draft.pdf, action-items-tracker.csv (proposed owners).

Asks: 
1) Can you confirm acceptance of the technical summary below and whether you want a follow-up technical-only call with our SREs?
2) We propose an SLA goodwill credit equivalent to 25% of May usage for the impacted window — see the attached AP-sla-credit-calc.xlsx for details. Please confirm that number is acceptable or tell us preferred approach for crediting (invoice offset vs. account credit).
3) For QBR: we plan to include a 2-slide exec summary + action tracker. If you’d like to amend wording, please reply with edits by EOD Friday (May 12).

I’m happy to jump on a quick call this morning if useful — proposing 10:30 PT.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Jay Campbell <jay.campbell@atlaspay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasPay Ops <ops@atlaspay.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet

Thanks Priya — we appreciate the quick draft. A few quick notes: 

1) The impact window in our telemetry looks like it pushed to 13:44 UTC on some retries — can you confirm whether the 13:42 is when backend succeeded but client retries still observed issues? We need the exact customer-visible window for our regulators.
2) The proposed 25% credit sounds reasonable but we need an invoice-offset rather than an account credit — can you confirm that’s doable?
3) Yes to a technical postmortem call; 10:30 PT works for me, Jay. If the SREs could include a short runbook update, that’d be ideal.

Looking forward to the final version.

Best,
Jay

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, AtlasPay Ops <ops@atlaspay.com>, Jay Campbell <jay.campbell@atlaspay.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet

Thanks Priya — quick operational clarifications and proposed customer wording for the credit section.

Operational notes:
- Customer-visible window: we confirmed with logs that backend acceptance resumed at 13:42:18 UTC; however client retries caused elevated error responses until 13:44:12 UTC for a small subset of regions. Proposed published impact window: 13:14:00 — 13:44:12 UTC (30 minutes).
- Root cause: a manual rollback of an edge load-balancer template rolled back a cache priming change; the rollback did not trigger a cache-warm task on 3 of 12 hosts.

Credit calc (attached AP-sla-credit-calc.xlsx): we recommend 25% for the impacted hour prorated by your actual traffic fraction = 18.6% effective credit on May invoice. We can apply that as an invoice offset.

Proposed customer-facing wording to include in final postmortem:
"Redwood Inference acknowledges the interruption on May 10 and is issuing an invoice offset equal to 18.6% of AtlasPay's May usage to address the impacted window. We will reflect this on the June invoice; if you prefer a direct account credit, let us know and we will accommodate"

Action for CS: Priya to confirm final wording and send to AtlasPay. Action for Finance: Laura to confirm invoice-offset flow. Action for SRE: Marissa to add cache-warm step to deploy runbook and create an automated monitor for host cache fill.

-Vivek

On Fri, May 11, 2028 at 10:03 AM Jay Campbell <jay.campbell@atlaspay.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, AtlasPay Ops <ops@atlaspay.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet

Looping in concrete owners and deadlines into the action-items-tracker.csv (attached). High-level assignments below: 

- Marissa Cole (SRE lead): implement cache-warm post-rollback and add monitor for host cache fill — due 2028-05-18 EOD (JIRA SUP-2147).
- Vivek Kulkarni: validate credit calc and approve customer wording — due 2028-05-12 10:00 PT.
- Laura Bennett (Finance): confirm invoice-offset flow & accounting entries — due 2028-05-15 EOD.
- Priya Natarajan (CS): finalize customer-facing postmortem and send to AtlasPay; schedule 30-min tech call (if requested) — due 2028-05-12 17:00 PT.
- Hannah Schmitt (Product): include remediation work in next sprint planning and report back on ETA for UI telemetry updates — due 2028-05-22.

Runbook link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1runbook-cache-warm

I also added two low-effort mitigations that we can push this week: a pre-deploy cache-priming check and an alert if >10% hosts show cold-cache after deploy.

-M

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Jay Campbell <jay.campbell@atlaspay.com>, AtlasPay Ops <ops@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 17:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasPay service interruption — postmortem, credits & QBR packet

Jay / AtlasPay team —

Thanks for the quick review and call earlier. Per our internal decisions and the attachments above, please find the finalized items: 

1) Final impact window published: 2028-05-10 13:14:00 — 2028-05-10 13:44:12 UTC (30 minutes).
2) Final postmortem attached: AP-postmortem-final.pdf (includes root cause analysis and timeline).
3) Credit: Redwood will apply an invoice offset equal to 18.6% of your May usage (as described in AP-sla-credit-calc.xlsx). This will be reflected on your June invoice. If you need a different mechanism, reply and we will adjust.
4) Action owner commitments: see action-items-tracker.csv; SRE remediation due 2028-05-18; Finance confirmation by 2028-05-15.

For the QBR deck, we will include a short executive summary slide and the action tracker; Priya will lead the QBR narrative for this item.

If there are any remaining edits to the postmortem wording, please reply by Monday 2028-05-14 COB. Otherwise we will publish the postmortem to the shared drive and include the slide in the QBR packet.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AP-postmortem-final.pdf
